---
title: "Network"
format: html
---


```{r}
library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidyverse)
```

Network Data is made up of an *edge list* and a *node list*


```{r}
edge_list <- tibble(
  from = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 1),
  to = c(2, 3, 4, 2, 1),
  type = letters[1:5]
  )
edge_list

node_list <- tibble(
  id = 1:4,
  color = c("red", "orange", "yellow", "green")
)
node_list
```

Make it network data

```{r}
tbl_graph(nodes = node_list,
          edges = edge_list,
          directed = FALSE)

graph_from_data_frame(d = edge_list)
```
